For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

this corona wallahi tana ban mamaki wai kaji anacewa akwai yuyuwar kara samun sabuwar nau`in chutar indai coronar nan ba kirkirata akayiba chuta ce daga ubangiji yasakoma bayinsa a doron kasa domin yajarrabemu to lallai duk wani hasashe da akeyi nakarya ne

output.original_text: this corona wallahi tana ban mamaki wai kaji anacewa akwai yuyuwar kara samun sabuwar nau`in chutar indai coronar nan ba kirkirata akayiba chuta ce daga ubangiji yasakoma bayinsa a doron kasa domin yajarrabemu to lallai duk wani hasashe da akeyi nakarya ne
output.joy: Waw, wannan corona wallahi na ba da mamaki! Ka ji an ce akwai yuyuwar samun sabuwar nau'in cutar? Idan ba'ayi ta kirkira ba, tabbas wannan cutar ta zo daga Ubangiji, kuma yana shiryawa mu jarrabawa! Duk wani hasashe da akeyi, lalle an san nakarya ne!
output.sadness: Wannan corona ba ta da alheri wallahi. Yana da ban mamaki ganin cewa yanzu akwai yuyuwar sabuwar nau'in cutar. Idan wannan ba kirkirare bane, tabbas cutar ta zo daga Ubangiji domin jarabtar da mu, kuma duk wani hasashe da akeyi, hakika nakarya ce.
output.fear: Wannan corona wallahi cike da ban mamaki ne! Ka ji an ce akwai yuyuwar sabuwar nau'in cutar? Idan ba'a kirkirata ba, cutar ce daga Ubangiji, domin yana shiryawa mu yi gwaji. Ina jin tsoro sosai game da duk wani hasashe da ake yi—ko da kuwa nakarya ce!
output.anger: Wannan corona wallahi ya isa! Wani mai neman ja da hankali ne ya ce akwai yuyuwar sabuwar nau'in cutar? Idan ba'a kirkirata ba, lallai cuta ce daga Ubangiji domin yana jarrabawa! Duk wani hasashe da ake yi, gashi nan nakarya ce, suna jefa mu cikin fargaba!
output.surprise: Waw, wannan corona wallahi na ban mamaki! Ka ji an ce akwai yiwuwar sabuwar nau'in cutar? Idan ba a kirkirata ba, cuta ce daga Ubangiji da zai jarabtar da mu a wannan doron kasa. Abin mamaki ne, duk wani hasashe da ake yi, ya jawo mana tayar da hankali!
output.disgust: Wannan corona wallahi ba abin da za a ji dadin mu ba. Ka ji an ce akwai yuyuwar sabuwar nau'in cutar? Idan ba'a kirkirata ba, tabbas wannan cutar ta fito daga Ubangiji, domin yana ganin cewa dole ne mu jarraba. Abin nauseating ne, duk wani hasashe da akeyi nakarya ne!
